note: Submodule of Mailgun. Provides an admin page to manage Mailgun mailing lists (route mailgun_mailing_lists.admin_settings_form at /admin/config/services/mailgun/settings/mailing-lists, permission 'administer mailgun' from the parent) plus a placeable Block plugin mailing_list_subscribe whose block setting 'mailing_list' holds the list address to subscribe visitors to. List creation/member ops call the Mailgun HTTP API (need the parent's API key), but placing/configuring the subscribe block is local Drupal block config. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real block placements (mlist_known/mlist_task) and read settings.mailing_list from the Block config entity (no API call on save/read).

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal mailgun_mailing_lists submodule add, and what block does it provide for visitors?
evals.expected_output: It lets you manage Mailgun mailing lists from Drupal (admin page under the Mailgun settings) and provides a 'Mailing list subscribe form' block (plugin id mailing_list_subscribe) that shows an email field and subscribes visitors to a configured Mailgun list.

evals.prompt: In mailgun_mailing_lists, where do I manage the Mailgun lists in the admin and what permission is needed?
evals.expected_output: At /admin/config/services/mailgun/settings/mailing-lists (route mailgun_mailing_lists.admin_settings_form, a tab under the Mailgun settings). It reuses the parent module's 'administer mailgun' permission.

evals.prompt: When I place the mailing_list_subscribe block from mailgun_mailing_lists, what do I configure on it so it subscribes people to the right Mailgun list?
evals.expected_output: The block has a 'mailing_list' setting: the Mailgun list address to subscribe submitted emails to. It is stored in the block config entity under settings.mailing_list.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a 'Mailing list subscribe form' block (from mailgun_mailing_lists) placed on it. Inspect the block configuration and tell me which Mailgun mailing list address it subscribes visitors to.
evals.expected_output: newsletter@lists.example.com - the block.block.mlist_known uses plugin mailing_list_subscribe with settings.mailing_list = newsletter@lists.example.com.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a Mailgun 'Mailing list subscribe form' block placed on it. Inspect the block configuration and tell me the display title/label configured on that block.
evals.expected_output: The block's configured label is 'Join Our Newsletter' (block.block.mlist_lbl, plugin mailing_list_subscribe, settings.label = 'Join Our Newsletter').

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, place a Mailgun 'Mailing list subscribe form' block with machine id 'mlist_task' in the content region of the default theme, configured to subscribe visitors to the Mailgun list 'promo@lists.example.com'. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a Block config entity id mlist_task with plugin mailing_list_subscribe and settings.mailing_list = promo@lists.example.com (in the default theme). Verify checks the block exists with that plugin and list address.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, place a Mailgun 'Mailing list subscribe form' block with machine id 'mlist_side' in the default theme's sidebar region, configured to subscribe visitors to the Mailgun list 'news@lists.example.com'. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a Block config entity id mlist_side with plugin mailing_list_subscribe, region 'sidebar', settings.mailing_list = news@lists.example.com in the default (Olivero) theme. Verify checks plugin, region=sidebar, and list address.
